whatAre.title: What are shrink wrap covers?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about shrink wrap covers

items.q: How much does boat shrink wrapping cost?
items.a: The price depends on the size and model of the boat. Example prices for made-to-measure shrink wrap covers: Buster L €230.80, Targa 23.1 €351 and Axopar 28 €358.80. On-site shrink wrapping in the Helsinki Capital Region costs €45 per meter (VAT 0%) for console boats under 10 m. Ask for a quote for larger boats and group pricing for multiple boats.

items.q: What is a shrink wrap cover and how does it differ from traditional shrink wrapping?
items.a: A shrink wrap cover is a cover sized in advance to the boat's model or measurements. It is lifted over the boat and heat-shrunk tight. A traditional roll of shrink film weighs about 50 kg, is laborious to install and leaves a lot of offcuts. A ready-made cover means less plastic and faster installation.

items.q: What material are the shrink wrap covers made of?
items.a: The covers are made from durable UV-stabilized polyethylene (PE/LDPE) with a typical thickness of 150–200 µm. The cover keeps the boat clean and protects it from rain, ice and sea salt.

items.q: How long does it take to install a shrink wrap cover?
items.a: The cover is placed over the boat and shrunk with a heat gun or gas burner. For example, an Axopar 28 was wrapped by two people in 45 minutes.

items.q: How do I order a shrink wrap cover for my boat?
items.a: Send the boat model, measurements or drawings using the contact form, by WhatsApp to +358 400 283 123 or by email to jari@kelmutus.fi. We will send you a quote and make the cover to your boat's measurements.

items.q: Do you deliver across Finland, and is on-site installation available?
items.a: Yes. Made-to-measure shrink wrap covers are delivered across Finland in 2–3 weeks, and elsewhere in Europe when needed. On-site installation is available especially in the Helsinki Capital Region and on the coast between Turku and Kokkola (Turku, Uusikaupunki, Rauma, Pori, Kristiinankaupunki, Vaasa, Pietarsaari, Kokkola). Installation elsewhere for an additional fee.

items.q: Does a shrink-wrapped boat need ventilation during winter storage?
items.a: Yes. Ventilation vents and an inspection window are available as accessories for the cover. During winter storage, leave hatches and doors slightly open and make sure the shrink wrap has ventilation openings.

items.q: Can you shrink wrap things other than boats?
items.a: Yes. We also shrink wrap cars, industrial machinery and equipment, buildings and special items, either with a made-to-measure cover or on site.

items.q: Can I install a shrink wrap cover myself?
items.a: Yes. The cover is lifted over the boat and shrunk with a heat gun or gas burner. For example, installing a cover on an Axopar 28 takes two people about 45 minutes. If you don't have the tools or experience, we can come and install it on site.

items.q: Which is better, a shrink wrap cover or a tarp?
items.a: A shrink wrap cover is tighter, doesn't flap in the wind and needs no frame. A tarp is reusable but needs a sturdy frame. Read the full comparison.

meta.title: Boat winter storage: guide, storage options and protection | Kelmutus.fi
meta.description: Boat winter storage outdoors, in a cold or heated hall. A checklist, protection options and tips for choosing between a tarp and a shrink wrap cover.

talvisailytys.title: Boat winter storage – guide and checklist
talvisailytys.intro: Careful preparation protects your boat from moisture, mold and frost damage over the winter. Go through this checklist before the boat is laid up for the season.
talvisailytys.lead: There are three ways to store a boat over the winter: outdoors on stands or a trailer, in a cold hall or in a heated hall. Outdoor storage is the most affordable, but then the boat's protection decides how well it copes with snow, ice and moisture. On this page you will find a winter storage checklist and a comparison of the different protection options.

options.title: Winter storage options
rows: Outdoors on stands or a trailer
Weather protection depends on the cover
The most affordable. The boat needs a tight cover and sturdy support.
The engine and water systems must still be drained to prevent freezing.
The most expensive option. Suitable for valuable and wooden boats.
options.body: For outdoor storage, the boat is covered either with a tarp and a cover frame or with a made-to-measure shrink wrap cover. Both work as long as the cover is tight and the boat is ventilated.

covering.title: Covering a boat for winter – tarp or shrink wrap cover?
covering.tarp: is reusable, but it needs a sturdy cover frame so that snow and water don't collect in pockets. The tarp must not touch the boat's surface, because a tarp rubbing in the wind wears down the gelcoat.
covering.bag: is heat-shrunk tightly to the shape of the boat. It doesn't flap in the wind, snow slides off the tight surface, and no separate frame is needed. For example, installing a made-to-measure shrink wrap cover on an Axopar 28 takes two people about 45 minutes.
covering.comparePrefix: A more detailed comparison with prices:
covering.compareLink: Shrink wrap cover or tarp for boat winter storage?

outdoor.title: Checklist for outdoor storage
items: Wash and dry the boat before covering it. A damp boat will get moldy under the cover.
Support the boat on stands or a trailer so that the weight is evenly distributed and the stern is slightly lower than the bow.
Leave the hull drain plugs open.
Make sure there is ventilation: gaps at the bow and stern under a tarp, ventilation vents in a shrink wrap cover.
Check the cover after storms and heavy snowfall.

regions.title: Winter storage and shrink wrapping by region
regions.body: Kelmutus.fi delivers made-to-measure shrink wrap covers across Finland in 2–3 weeks. We come on site to shrink wrap especially in the Helsinki Capital Region and on the coast between Turku and Kokkola: Turku, Uusikaupunki, Rauma, Pori, Kristiinankaupunki, Vaasa, Pietarsaari and Kokkola. In urgent cases we can even come the same day. Ask us about other locations in Finland and Europe too.

items.q: How do you store a boat over the winter?
items.a: The boat is washed, the engine and water systems are serviced and drained, the batteries are removed or kept charged, and the boat is supported on stands or a trailer. Outdoors, the boat is covered tightly with a tarp and a cover frame or with a shrink wrap cover so that it can still ventilate.

items.q: Can a boat be stored outdoors over the winter?
items.a: Yes. Outdoor storage is the most affordable option when the boat is carefully supported and protected. A tight shrink wrap cover or a good tarp with a frame protects against snow, ice and UV radiation.

items.q: Which is better for winter storage, a tarp or a shrink wrap cover?
items.a: A shrink wrap cover is tighter, doesn't flap in the wind and needs no frame. A tarp is reusable but needs a frame and regular checks. See the comparison.

items.q: When should a boat be covered for the winter?
items.a: Right after the boat has been lifted out and washed, once it is dry. It's worth ordering a made-to-measure shrink wrap cover in good time, as the delivery time is 2–3 weeks.

cta.title: Need help with winter storage for your boat?
cta.body: We make a made-to-measure shrink wrap cover for your boat, shrink wrap it on site in the Helsinki Capital Region and can also take care of winter service.

cleanSurfaces.label: Clean surfaces:
cleanSurfaces.text: Wash the boat’s interior (cabinets, surfaces) with mild soapy water or diluted vinegar water.

removeMoisture.label: Remove moisture:
removeMoisture.text: Ventilate the boat thoroughly. Make sure there is no water left in hoses, the fridge, or other recesses.

dryThoroughly.label: Dry thoroughly:
dryThoroughly.text: Let all surfaces dry completely, as moisture promotes mold growth.

items.dehumidifier: Use moisture absorbers, e.g. an Absodry dehumidifier from Motonet.

fillTank.label: Fill the tank:
fillTank.text: Keep the fuel tank full to prevent condensation.

protectEngine.label: Protect the engine:
protectEngine.text: Use antifreeze (glycol) or another freeze protection product according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

service.label: Service:
service.text: Change oils and filters, and empty or replace the water separator filter.

removeSensitive.label: Remove moisture-sensitive items:
removeSensitive.text: Take out textiles, tools, electronics and other loose items.

storeBatteries.label: Store batteries properly:
storeBatteries.text: Disconnect the batteries and store them in a dry, warm place for the winter.

washRopes.label: Wash ropes:
washRopes.text: Rinse ropes with fresh water and dry them well before storage.

shrinkWrap.label: Shrink-wrap the boat:
shrinkWrap.text: A made-to-measure shrink wrap cover protects the boat from dirt, rain, ice and sea salt.

ventilation.label: Ensure ventilation:
ventilation.text: Leave hatches and doors slightly open, and make sure there are ventilation openings in the shrink wrap.

emptyBilge.label: Empty the bilge:
emptyBilge.text: Open the drain plug and check that no water remains in the bilge. If needed, remove the rest with a wet vacuum. Also check that the bilge pump works.

drainWaterSystems.label: Drain water systems:
drainWaterSystems.text: Drain the fresh water system and pour antifreeze into the toilet bowl.

items.finalNote: Your boat is now ready for spring — you can safely start planning the routes for the next season ☺

meta.description: Shrink wrap cover vs. boat tarp: price, installation, durability, snow and ventilation. How to choose the right winter protection for your boat.

kutistepussiVaiPressu.title: Shrink wrap cover or tarp for boat winter storage?
kutistepussiVaiPressu.intro: A shrink wrap cover suits you if you want tight, hassle-free winter protection without a separate frame. A tarp suits you if you want a reusable cover and already have a sturdy cover frame. With either, the boat keeps well as long as the cover is tight and the boat can ventilate.

compare.title: Comparison
rows: Heat-shrunk to the shape of the boat
Loose, needs tightening with ropes or straps
The frame prevents pockets if it is sturdy
Can flap and rub against the boat's surface
Gaps at the bow and stern
E.g. Axopar 28 in about 45 min with two people
Assembling the frame and fastening the tarp
Ready-made boat covers in stores about €50–350 and a cover frame about €175–260 (November 2026)

whenBag.title: When is a shrink wrap cover the better choice?
items: The boat is outdoors in a windy spot, for example on the coast.
You want protection that doesn't need checking after every storm.
You don't have a cover frame or don't want to build one.
You want a neat, tight result for transport as well.

whenTarp.title: When is a tarp the better choice?
items: You already have a sturdy cover frame.
The boat is in a sheltered spot.
You want to use the same cover for several winters and check it regularly.

price.title: How much does a shrink wrap cover cost?
price.body: The price of a made-to-measure shrink wrap cover depends on the size and model of the boat. Example prices (VAT 0%): Buster L €230.80, Targa 23.1 €351 and Axopar 28 €358.80. On-site shrink wrapping in the Helsinki Capital Region costs €45 per meter for console boats under 10 m. Request a quote for your boat: send us the boat model, measurements or drawings.

items.q: Can a shrink wrap cover handle a snow load?
items.a: A shrink wrap cover is shrunk tightly to the shape of the boat, so snow can't collect in pockets the way it does on a loose tarp. It's still a good idea to check the cover after heavy snowfall.

items.q: Does a shrink wrap cover need ventilation underneath?
items.a: Yes. Ventilation vents are available for the shrink wrap cover, and it's a good idea to leave the boat's hatches and doors slightly open so that moisture doesn't condense.

items.q: Can I install a shrink wrap cover myself?
items.a: Yes. The cover is lifted over the boat and shrunk with a heat gun or gas burner. If you don't have the tools or experience, we can also install it for you on site.

items.q: How quickly can I get a shrink wrap cover?
items.a: The delivery time for a made-to-measure shrink wrap cover is 2–3 weeks anywhere in Finland.

talvikatos.title: Boat winter shelters and repair shelters from shrink wrap
talvikatos.intro: A winter shelter, or repair shelter, built from shrink wrap protects the boat over the winter and also gives you a covered workspace for servicing and repairing the boat. The shelter is built around the boat where it is stored, so the boat doesn't need to be moved into a hall.

when.title: When is a winter shelter worth it?
items: Service, repair or refurbishment work is being done on the boat during the winter.
The boat is large or shaped so that a ready-made cover won't fit.
No hall space is available, or it is too expensive.
You want to protect several boats or other items under the same shelter.

how.title: How is a winter shelter built?
how.body: A frame is built around the boat, covered with shrink film and heat-shrunk tight. The shelter can have a door opening and ventilation, so you can work inside even in winter.

area.title: Area and quotes
area.body: We build winter shelters in the Helsinki Capital Region and on the coast between Turku and Kokkola (Turku, Uusikaupunki, Rauma, Pori, Kristiinankaupunki, Vaasa, Pietarsaari, Kokkola), and elsewhere in Finland and Europe on request. The price depends on the size of the site, so request a quote: tell us the size of the boat, its location and your preferred schedule.

items.q: Can a shrink-wrapped repair shelter be built around a boat for the winter?
items.a: Yes. A shrink-wrapped winter shelter is built around the boat where it is stored, and it serves as both protection and a workspace over the winter.

items.q: How much does a boat winter shelter cost?
items.a: The price depends on the size of the boat and the structure of the shelter. Request a quote by telling us the boat's measurements and location.

2.title: 2) What personal data do we collect?
2.intro: We collect information when you send us a quote request or contact us:

list.name: Name
list.message: Message content (e.g., details and dimensions of the item)

2.extra: In addition, technical log data may be generated from using the website (e.g., IP address, browser details, timestamp), which is needed to ensure the site’s functionality and security.

3.title: 3) Why do we process the data?
3.intro: We process the data so that we can:

list.reply: reply to your message and provide a quote
list.followup: ask for additional details and handle communication regarding quotes or customer matters

4.title: 4) Legal basis for processing
4.intro: We process the data primarily on the basis of:

contract.bold: entering into a contract / taking steps prior to entering into a contract

5.title: 5) Do we disclose data to others?
5.noSell: We do not sell personal data.
5.providers: We may use trusted service providers (e.g., hosting, email/IT) who process data on our behalf only to provide the service. Data is disclosed to authorities only if required by law.

6.title: 6) How long do we retain the data?
6.intro: We retain data related to contacts and quote requests as long as necessary to handle the matter, and delete it within a reasonable time unless:

list.law: the law requires longer retention (e.g., accounting-related records).

7.title: 7) Your rights

list.info: receive information about the processing of your personal data
list.erase: request deletion of your data in certain situations
list.object: object to processing in certain situations

7.contactPrefix: You can exercise your rights by contacting:

8.title: 8) Right to lodge a complaint
8.intro: If you believe your personal data has been processed unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority:

authority.name: Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi)

9.title: 9) Security
9.text: We protect the data using appropriate technical and organizational measures and restrict access to the data only to those who need it for their work.
